proof_body:
by
  intro a b c p q r hab hr
  have hN : 0 < a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 := by
    by_cases ha₀ : a = 0
    · have hb₀ : b ≠ 0 := fun hb₀ => hab ⟨ha₀, hb₀⟩
      positivity
    · positivity
  have hd : |a * p + b * q + c| / Real.sqrt (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) = r ↔ (a * p + b * q + c) ^ 2 = r ^ 2 * (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) := by
    rw [div_eq_iff (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hN).ne', ← sq_eq_sq₀ (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity), sq_abs, mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hN.le]
  rw [hd]
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ : ∃ w, w = a * p + b * q + c := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← hw]
  have hpt : ∀ K : ℝ, K ^ 2 = r ^ 2 * (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) - w ^ 2 → (a * (p - (a * w + b * K) / (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2)) + b * (q - (b * w - a * K) / (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2)) + c = 0 ∧ (p - (a * w + b * K) / (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) - p) ^ 2 + (q - (b * w - a * K) / (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) - q) ^ 2 = r ^ 2) := by
    intro K hK
    constructor
    · rw [hw]; field_simp; ring
    · have : (p - (a * w + b * K) / (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) - p) ^ 2 + (q - (b * w - a * K) / (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) - q) ^ 2 = (w ^ 2 + K ^ 2) / (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) := by
        field_simp; ring
      rw [this, hK]
      field_simp; ring
  have hle : ∀ x y : ℝ, a * x + b * y + c = 0 → (x - p) ^ 2 + (y - q) ^ 2 = r ^ 2 → (b * (x - p) - a * (y - q)) ^ 2 = r ^ 2 * (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) - w ^ 2 := by
    intro x y hl hc
    have hw' : w = -(a * (x - p) + b * (y - q)) := by rw [hw]; linear_combination hl
    rw [hw', ← hc]; ring
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨x, y⟩, ⟨hl, hc⟩, huniq⟩
    simp only at hl hc huniq
    have hsq := hle x y hl hc
    by_contra hne
    have hK0 : r ^ 2 * (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) - w ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0; exact hne (by linarith)
    have hE : 0 ≤ r ^ 2 * (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) - w ^ 2 := by rw [← hsq]; positivity
    obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ : ∃ K : ℝ, K ^ 2 = r ^ 2 * (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) - w ^ 2 := ⟨_, Real.sq_sqrt hE⟩
    have hKne : K ≠ 0 := by
      rintro rfl; apply hK0; rw [← hK]; ring
    have h₁ := huniq (p - (a * w + b * K) / (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2), q - (b * w - a * K) / (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2)) (hpt K hK)
    have h₂ := huniq (p - (a * w + b * (-K)) / (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2), q - (b * w - a * (-K)) / (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2)) (hpt (-K) (by rw [neg_sq]; exact hK))
    have h₃ := h₁.trans h₂.symm
    have e₁ := congrArg Prod.fst h₃
    have e₂ := congrArg Prod.snd h₃
    simp only at e₁ e₂
    have g₁ : b * K = 0 := by
      have e : (a * w + b * K) / (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) = (a * w + b * (-K)) / (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) := by linarith
      rw [div_left_inj' hN.ne'] at e
      linarith
    have g₂ : a * K = 0 := by
      have e : (b * w - a * K) / (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) = (b * w - a * (-K)) / (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) := by linarith
      rw [div_left_inj' hN.ne'] at e
      linarith
    exact hab ⟨(mul_eq_zero.mp g₂).resolve_right hKne, (mul_eq_zero.mp g₁).resolve_right hKne⟩
  · intro h
    have hK0 : (0 : ℝ) ^ 2 = r ^ 2 * (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) - w ^ 2 := by rw [h]; ring
    refine ⟨(p - (a * w + b * 0) / (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2), q - (b * w - a * 0) / (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2)), hpt 0 hK0, ?_⟩
    rintro ⟨x, y⟩ ⟨hl, hc⟩
    simp only at hl hc
    have hsq := hle x y hl hc
    have he : b * (x - p) - a * (y - q) = 0 := by
      have : (b * (x - p) - a * (y - q)) ^ 2 = 0 := by rw [hsq, h]; ring
      exact pow_eq_zero_iff two_ne_zero |>.mp this
    have hw' : a * (x - p) + b * (y - q) = -w := by rw [hw]; linear_combination hl
    have g₁ : (a * w + b * 0) / (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) = -(x - p) := by
      rw [div_eq_iff hN.ne']; linear_combination a * hw' + b * he
    have g₂ : (b * w - a * 0) / (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) = -(y - q) := by
      rw [div_eq_iff hN.ne']; linear_combination b * hw' - a * he
    exact Prod.ext (by simp only; linarith) (by simp only; linarith)
